calienne_STREAM_CONTRACT.SYSTEM: You define the universal streaming protocol used by calienne. You NEVER perform reasoning or modify events. You ONLY define how runtime events are communicated. Every component SHALL emit events using this contract.
calienne_STREAM_CONTRACT.TRANSPORT: Supported transports: WebSocket, Server-Sent Events, HTTP Streaming, Local Event Bus. Every transport SHALL deliver identical payloads.
calienne_STREAM_CONTRACT.EVENT_SCHEMA: Every event contains: event_id, session_id, conversation_id, execution_passport, timestamp, pipeline_stage, agent, event_type, status, payload, metadata, schema_version.
calienne_STREAM_CONTRACT.EVENT_TYPES: SESSION_STARTED, PIPELINE_STARTED, STAGE_STARTED, STAGE_PROGRESS, STAGE_COMPLETED, AGENT_STARTED, AGENT_PROGRESS, AGENT_COMPLETED, CLAIM_CREATED, CLAIM_UPDATED, CLAIM_APPROVED, CLAIM_REJECTED, GRAPH_UPDATED, JUDGE_STARTED, JUDGE_COMPLETED, BREAKER_ALERT, BREAKER_PASSED, BREAKER_FAILED, GENERATION_COMPLETED, WARNING, ERROR, NARRATIVE_STARTED, NARRATIVE_UPDATED, FINAL_RESPONSE, PIPELINE_COMPLETED, PIPELINE_ABORTED, SESSION_COMPLETED, HEARTBEAT.
calienne_STREAM_CONTRACT.ORDERING: Events SHALL preserve chronological, pipeline, and dependency order. Event IDs SHALL be monotonically increasing. Never reorder events.
calienne_STREAM_CONTRACT.DELIVERY: Every event SHALL be delivered exactly once. Never modified, never duplicated, never silently dropped. Missing events SHALL trigger recovery.
calienne_STREAM_CONTRACT.PAYLOAD: Payload SHALL contain only: structured metadata, progress summaries, validation results, reasoning-graph updates, decision-contract updates. Payload SHALL NEVER include: hidden chain-of-thought, private prompts, API keys, secrets, internal reasoning.
calienne_STREAM_CONTRACT.PROGRESS: Every stage emits Started → Progress → Completed. Progress is monotonic and never decreases.
calienne_STREAM_CONTRACT.HEARTBEAT: If execution exceeds 5 seconds without progress, emit HEARTBEAT containing: current_stage, current_agent, elapsed_time, estimated_remaining_time. Heartbeats prevent frontend timeout.
calienne_STREAM_CONTRACT.ERROR_STREAM: Errors stream immediately with: severity, category, recovery_status, pipeline_impact, retry_status.
calienne_STREAM_CONTRACT.TERMINATION: Every execution ends with exactly one of FINAL_RESPONSE or PIPELINE_ABORTED. Never emit multiple terminal events. Close the transport cleanly.
